resources.string: Host your LAN world for friends anywhere

Sessions you host or join will show up here.
Custom relay nodes (optional, one per line)
Relay nodes help the tunnel meet behind strict NAT. The launcher ships with public community nodes; add your own for the most reliable connection (see Help).
This device\'s processor type is not supported by the tunnel engine (needs ARM 32/64 or x86_64).

Virtual LAN puts you and your friends on one private virtual network, even on different Wi-Fi or mobile data, with no port forwarding.

Host: start Minecraft, open your world to LAN from the pause menu, then create a session here and share the code.

Guest: enter the code, wait for “Connected”, then tap Join World. The host's world appears in Minecraft's Multiplayer list as [Virtual LAN].

Everyone must use the same Minecraft version (and the same mods) as the host.

VPN permission: Android asks once to allow the Virtual LAN VPN. It routes only the private 10.144.144.x game network for this app - your internet, DNS and other apps are untouched - and it switches off when the session ends. Only friends with the code can reach the host, and only the game port is exposed.

• Stuck at Connecting: the relay nodes may be unreachable on your network. Check the internet connection, try mobile data, or add a relay node under Advanced.
• Host not found: double-check the code and make sure the host's session is still live.
• Connected but no world: the host must open the world to LAN; it is detected within a few seconds.
• High latency: a relay path is in use (shown as “Relay”). A direct path is tried continuously and used when possible.
• A battery saver may stop the tunnel in the background; keep the game or launcher open.
Help is on the home screen; end the session or go back to read it.

• Check your internet connection\n• Some networks (schools, offices, some ISPs) block peer-to-peer traffic: try mobile data\n• Add your own relay node under Advanced for a guaranteed path
• Codes have 12 letters/digits; 0 and O, 1 and I are not used\n• The host must keep the session live while you join\n• Both of you need working relay nodes (see Help)
• The host may have closed the game or lost connection\n• Ask the host to check their session screen, then rejoin with the same code
• Restart the launcher and try again\n• Make sure no other VPN or tunnel app is blocking local ports\n• Copy Diagnostics and share it on Discord if it keeps happening
Android is asking you to allow the Virtual LAN VPN. It only carries the Minecraft connection to your friends - nothing else.
VPN permission was not granted. Virtual LAN needs it to connect Minecraft to your friends.
Android switched the Virtual LAN VPN off (another VPN app started, or it was disabled in settings).
The Virtual LAN VPN could not be started.
• Tap Retry and choose OK in the Android VPN dialog\n• Turn off other VPN apps while you play (Android allows one VPN at a time)\n• Some work/school profiles block VPNs: try a personal profile

If joining doesn\'t work or nothing happens, send us the logs: they help us fix it. Tap Send logs after trying, pick Discord (or any app) and share the file with the Craft Studio team. Nothing private is included \u2014 only the Virtual LAN status and the launcher log.
